reasons: narrow: The original subsidiary clause incorrectly multiplied a conditional component total-variation bound by covariate spanning-tree probabilities. Conditional total variation is bounded before averaging over covariates; the tree factors enter only in the expected number of connected components. The proposed statement removes that false stronger clause while preserving and proving the advertised Hamming-transport conclusion.

narrow: The original membership assertion omitted the necessary CATE smoothness calibration. Since \(\|\tau_s\|_{\mathcal H^\gamma}\asymp ab h^{-\gamma}\), taking \(\ell=h\to0\) with \(ab\asymp\ell^q\) and \(q<\gamma\) violates the fixed Holder radius. The added scale restriction is satisfied with equality up to constants by the lower-bound calibration and narrows only the invalid quantifier.

verdict.note: Approved both faithful proof-obligation repairs: calibrated witness membership and corrected conditional-TV/component-count separation preserve the field-level lower envelope.
